composition.serve_who: This sheet ("MAST BLOCK: DANFOSS PVG 32 - 6 FUNCTIONS", sheet 5 of 12) is a single PVG32 valve block located at the mast, with six labelled function slices each naming its served equipment directly in the header: LIFTING KEEL UP/DOWN and LIFTING KEEL LOCKS both serve the lifting keel (130-apm-lifting-keel, per mapping table and established facts already carrying rating/actuation/cartridges from this same sheet). MAST WINCH AFT PORT/FWD PORT/AFT STBD/FWD STBD each serve their respective named mast winch nodes (220-mast-winch-aft-port, 220-mast-winch-fwd-port, 220-mast-winch-aft-stbd, 220-mast-winch-fwd-stbd), consistent with the engineer-confirmed mapping table and established facts already on those four nodes. The shared P/T/LS/M rails, common inlet section (with the 300-bar main block relief and standalone spool-control pressure-reducing valve at far left), and the six PVG32 module housing itself are infrastructure of the mast block manifold (570-danfoss-pvg-32-mast-block), not of any individual function's equipment record.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Two adjacent slices are titled LIFTING KEEL UP/DOWN and LIFTING KEEL LOCKS; the mapping table sends both 'lifting keel' and 'lifting keel lock' aliases to 130-apm-lifting-keel, and this node already carries a 40 l/min PVEU rating and cartridge 11166832/157B5111 from this same sheet in prior facts.

functions.label: LIFTING KEEL UP/DOWN
functions.what_it_does: Proportionally drives the lifting keel actuator up or down via a 0-10V pilot signal on the PVG32 spool; open-center at rest so the pump can idle to tank when the keel is not being moved.
key_components: Main proportional directional spool (PVG32 40 l/min module, cartridge 11166832)
PVEU proportional pilot stage (0-10V) driving the spool
Pilot-operated check/counterbalance stack holding load on A and B ports when spool is centered
Work-port relief valves on A and B lines (settings printed as 220 and 60, unit not legible but bar per sheet convention — part number: capture at inspection if ever needed)
LS shuttle/orifice elements feeding LS_A/LS_B signal to the LS rail

flow_scenarios.path: P rail flows through the open-center spool directly to T return rail; A and B work ports blocked and held by the pilot-operated counterbalance stack, keel load locked in position

PVEU pilot shifts spool to A-side: P → spool → work port A → through counterbalance stack → keel actuator (down motion); return oil from B port → spool → T rail; LS_A reports A-port pressure to LS rail
PVEU pilot shifts spool to B-side: P → spool → work port B → through counterbalance stack → keel actuator (up motion); return oil from A port → spool → T rail; LS_B reports B-port pressure to LS rail

flow_scenarios.state: Overpressure on A or B work line
flow_scenarios.path: respective work-port relief (220 or presumed-bar setting on one line, 60 on the other) opens, diverting excess flow from that work port directly to the T/tank rail regardless of spool position

functions.dry_data: PVG32 module, spool 40 l/min, PVEU proportional 0-10V, open neutral position (DOWN <5V=A / UP >5V=B)

functions.label: LIFTING KEEL LOCKS
functions.what_it_does: Engages/releases the keel lock mechanism on ON/OFF command; closed-center at rest so the lock circuit holds its state with no flow when idle.
key_components: Solenoid pilot valve (PVEO ON/OFF, cartridge 11166838) actuating the main directional spool
Main directional 2-position spool, closed-center, IN=A / OUT=B (PVG32 5 l/min module)
Pilot-operated check/non-return element on the P feed to the spool
Work-port relief cartridge on the B branch (setting not legibly printed)
Pair of LS orifice/restrictor cartridges (marked 100) feeding an LS shuttle/selector that passes signal to LS_A/LS_B

flow_scenarios.path: spool blocks P from both A and B; lock mechanism held mechanically in place, no oil movement
PVEO pilot shifts spool: P → A port → lock actuator (unlock/actuate); displaced oil returns B port → spool → T rail
pressure at A and/or B work ports taps through the two orifice cartridges (marked 100) into a shuttle selector, which passes the higher signal onward to the LS_A/LS_B rail

functions.dry_data: PVG32 module, spool 5 l/min, PVEO ON/OFF, closed neutral position (IN=A / OUT=B)

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Slice titled MAST WINCH AFT PORT (EV-6.3) directly names this winch per the engineer-confirmed mapping table; established facts on this node already carry the 65 l/min PVED ON/OFF rating and cartridges 11166838/157B6203/11763831 from this sheet.

functions.label: MAST WINCH AFT PORT
functions.what_it_does: Drives the mast winch motor in either rotational direction on ON/OFF command from three spool positions (1st/3rd gear = A-side, 2nd gear = B-side); open-center neutral lets pump flow idle to tank when the winch is not commanded.
key_components: Main directional PVEO ON/OFF pilot valve (cartridge 11166838) actuating the main spool
Main directional spool (PVG32 65 l/min work section, cartridge 157B7123) with open-center neutral
Work-port relief cartridge on one work line, set to 250 bar
Work-port relief cartridge on the other work line, set to 225 bar
LS shuttle takeoff feeding LS_A/LS_B rail

flow_scenarios.path: P flow passes through the centered spool directly to T return; no flow to A or B work ports; LS line unloaded
solenoid pilot shifts spool: P → A work port → winch motor; return B port → spool → T; LS_A reports A-port pressure
solenoid pilot shifts spool opposite: P → B work port → winch motor (reverse); return A port → spool → T; LS_B reports B-port pressure
relief valve (250 bar) opens, diverting A-line oil to return/LS rail to limit pressure
relief valve (225 bar) opens, diverting B-line oil to return/LS rail to limit pressure

functions.dry_data: PVG32 module, spool 65 l/min, PVEO ON/OFF, open neutral position (1st&3rd gear=A / 2nd gear=B)

functions.label: MAST WINCH FWD PORT
functions.what_it_does: Drives the mast winch motor bidirectionally on ON/OFF command (1st/3rd gear = A-side, 2nd gear = B-side); open-center neutral idles pump flow to tank when not commanded, motor holds position via integral counterbalance/check.
key_components: Main directional spool (PVG32 module, cartridge 11166838), open-center neutral
Solenoid pilot valve (ON/OFF) atop the spool
Motor/winch drive cartridge with integral counterbalance/relief check (157B7123)
Work-port relief valve set to 250 bar
Work-port relief valve set to 225 bar
LS shuttle line feeding LS_B rail

pilot solenoid shifts spool: P → A port → winch motor inlet; B port returns to tank; winch drives in one direction
spool shifts opposite: P → B port → winch motor; A port returns to tank; winch drives in reverse direction
corresponding relief cartridge (250 or 225 bar) opens, dumping excess flow from that work port to tank/return
pressure at the active work port is sensed via cyan LS line and communicated to LS_B rail for load-sense compensation elsewhere in the manifold

functions.what_it_does: Drives the mast winch motor bidirectionally on ON/OFF command via a 3-position spool (1st/3rd gear=A, 2nd gear=B); open-center neutral idles flow to tank, load held on the non-pressurized port by dual counterbalance/overcenter valves.

Load-holding counterbalance/overcenter valves (one per work line, on motor block 157B7123), pilot-operated check with relief override

Work-port relief valve on B line, ~225 bar
Shuttle/check element selecting the higher LS signal from A or B to feed the LS rail

B-line relief (~225 bar) opens, dumping B port oil to tank return rail

infrastructure.system_name: Danfoss PVG 32 Mast Block (manifold housing, common rails, inlet section)
facts: Single PVG32, 6-function valve block located at the mast, housing all six function slices side by side (rev 10 of the SWS108 hydraulic system set, sheet 5 of 12).
Common horizontal rails run the length of the block: P (pressure supply), T (tank return), LS/LS_A/LS_B (load-sense), and M (gauge/measure port), shared across all six function slices.
Cartridge/line identifiers printed along the rails include 157B5111, 157B6203, 11130982, 157B2014 — these tag the shared rail segments, not any single function.
Standalone spool-control (pilot) pressure-reducing valve at the far left of the inlet section supplies reduced pilot/spool-control pressure to all six pilot stages on the block.
Main block inlet pressure-relief setting: 300 (bar, per sheet convention) protects the whole manifold inlet, located at the lower-left of the inlet section alongside a shuttle/check element.

Red warning triangles with numbers scattered across the slices are revision markers, cross-referenced to rows in the modification table (e.g. row 10 'PROPORTIONAL AFT WINCHES', row 9 'PRESSURE ADJUSTEMENT', row 8 'PRESSURE AFTER COMMISSIONING').
